attempts.text:
**The window starts on a spine.** Column 0, `ydfI`, a mannitol dehydrogenase family protein, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0.2% of calls. The model names it in 94% of calls, with 0.97 bits.

**Then 79 fork and variable columns**, in a region of plasticity in 8 to 90% of calls. A second branch of 23 families runs through columns 2 to 24, carried by 10 to 12% of chromosomes, 19 persistent and 4 shell: `rspB` to `mdtJ`. The most carried families there are `ydfZ` at 85%, the `mar` genes, and `yneE` at 84%.

**The `lsr` columns 25 to 33 are variable**, carried by 33 to 75% of chromosomes, all shell, from `lsrG` at 75% to `ydeK` at 33%. The model names the fewest genes at column 29, 73%. Then `hipB` and `hipA` fork at 79% and 73%.

**The most hesitant columns are here.** Column 42, `fimC`, 1.44 bits and in a region of plasticity in 77% of calls; column 37, `ydeQ`, 1.43 bits and 81%; column 36, `ydeR`, 1.42 bits and 86%. The 34 columns where most calls are in a region of plasticity are named in 82% of calls at 1.01 bits; the other 46 columns in 90% at 0.49 bits.

**The window closes on variable stretches**, `ddpX` to `narI` at 6 to 76%, then `yddE` to a hypothetical protein at column 79, carried by 16% of chromosomes. Across the window the model names 87% of genes at 0.71 bits; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.20 against 0.29 bits, and names fewer genes, 78% against 95%.

label: ydfI
facts:
WINDOW: the ydfI window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ydfI, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,190 to 2,269 from dnaA. Read in 513 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ydfI once); 41,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 87% of genes, 0.71 bits on average (perplexity 2.0 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 20,718 calls, named 97%, 0.26 bits; shell 19,196 calls, named 80%, 1.00 bits; cloud 1,126 calls, named 25%, 4.17 bits. Outside an RGP 22,148 calls, named 95%, 0.29 bits; inside an RGP 18,892 calls, named 78%, 1.20 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 35 fork, 44 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.20 against 0.29 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 95%); 18,892 of the 41,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 42 (fimC) 1.44 bits, RGP 77%; column 37 (ydeQ) 1.43 bits, RGP 81%; column 36 (ydeR) 1.42 bits, RGP 86%. The 34 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 82%, 1.01 bits on average; the other 46 columns: named 90%, 0.49 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 8-90%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0.2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: ydfI "mannitol dehydrogenase family prote…". named 94%; 0.97 bits.
